description: Flat metadata schema for individual single amplified genome records from archaeal communities sampled from extreme environments, including sample provenance, environmental parameters, lysis and amplification workflow, sequencing, and assembly details.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample/SAG record within the dataset.

biosample_accession.descr: External biosample accession or sample registry ID, if available (e.g., ENA/SRA/BioSample identifier).

collection_site_name.descr: Human-readable name of the sampling location or site (e.g., hydrothermal vent field name).

environment_type.descr: Controlled term describing the habitat type; examples: hydrothermal vent, hot spring, deep-sea sediment, hypersaline brine, acidic spring.

site_description.descr: Free-text description of the sampling context, including notable geological or ecological features.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_or_depth_m.descr: Sampling elevation above sea level or depth below surface in meters; use negative values or site convention consistently and document in site_description if needed.

collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the sample/cells; examples: water filtration, sediment coring, submersible sampling, syringe sampling.

sample_material.descr: Primary material sampled; examples: water, sediment, biofilm, chimney, mat, microbial aggregate.

host_association.descr: Whether the archaeal cells were free-living or associated with a host/surface; examples: free-living, symbiotic, attached, mixed.

temperature_c.descr: In situ environmental temperature in degrees Celsius at the time/place of collection.

pH.descr: In situ pH of the sample environment.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity in practical salinity units (PSU), if measured.

pressure_mpa.descr: In situ hydrostatic or environmental pressure in megapascals (MPa), if measured.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in mg/L, if measured.

redox_potential_mV.descr: Oxidation-reduction potential in millivolts (mV), if measured.

conductivity_uS_cm.descr: Electrical conductivity in microsiemens per centimeter (uS/cm), if measured.

turbidity_ntu.descr: Turbidity of the collected water sample in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU), if measured.

cell_enrichment_or_sorting_method.descr: Method used to enrich, isolate, or sort single cells prior to lysis; examples: FACS, microfluidic sorting, micromanipulation, dilution-to-extinction.

lysis_method.descr: Cell lysis strategy used before amplification; examples: alkaline lysis, enzymatic lysis, heat lysis, freeze-thaw, combined protocol.

lysis_reagents_or_enzymes.descr: Key reagents, enzymes, or buffers used in lysis (e.g., proteinase K, lysozyme, SDS, NaOH).

lysis_incubation_temperature_c.descr: Incubation temperature used during lysis in degrees Celsius, if applicable.

lysis_incubation_time_min.descr: Incubation time for lysis in minutes, if applicable.

amplification_method.descr: Whole-genome amplification method; examples: multiple displacement amplification (MDA), MALBAC, PicoPLEX.

amplification_kit_name.descr: Name of the commercial amplification kit used, if applicable.

amplification_kit_version.descr: Kit version or lot-related specification relevant to the amplification workflow, if known.

phi29_polymerase_used.descr: Whether phi29 DNA polymerase was used in the amplification workflow.

amplification_template_amount_ng.descr: Estimated amount of input DNA template in nanograms, if known.

amplification_reaction_volume_ul.descr: Total reaction volume used for whole-genome amplification in microliters (uL).

amplification_incubation_temperature_c.descr: Temperature used for isothermal amplification in degrees Celsius.

amplification_incubation_time_h.descr: Duration of isothermal amplification in hours.

amplification_negative_control_used.descr: Whether a negative control was included during amplification.

amplification_yield_ng.descr: Total amplified DNA yield in nanograms, if measured.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing technology/platform used; examples: Illumina NovaSeq, HiSeq, NextSeq, PacBio Sequel II, Oxford Nanopore PromethION.

sequencing_library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation workflow used prior to sequencing, including kit or protocol name.

sequencing_read_layout.descr: Sequencing read structure; examples: single-end, paired-end, long-read.

sequencing_read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for short-read sequencing, or typical read length if applicable.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier or instrument run accession.

sequencing_date.descr: Date the sequencing run or library sequencing was performed.

raw_reads_accession.descr: Accession for raw sequencing reads in a public repository, if available.

adapter_trimming_tool.descr: Software used to remove adapters and low-quality bases from reads.

quality_filtering_tool.descr: Software used for quality filtering of sequencing reads, if applicable.

assembly_software.descr: Genome assembly tool used to generate the SAG assembly; examples: SPAdes, metaSPAdes, MEGAHIT, Flye.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key non-default assembly parameters or command-line settings used, if any.

polishing_software.descr: Software used to polish or error-correct the assembly, if applicable.

polishing_software_version.descr: Version of the polishing software, if applicable.

binning_method.descr: Method used to bin or recover the genome, if applicable; examples: single-cell assembly only, binning, manual curation.

contamination_estimate_percent.descr: Estimated contamination percentage of the assembled SAG/genome.

quality_assessment_tool.descr: Tool used to estimate completeness/contamination or SAG quality; examples: CheckM, CheckM2, GUNC.

assembly_size_bp.descr: Total assembled genome size in base pairs.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs in the final assembly.

n50_bp.descr: N50 contig length in base pairs.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the final assembly in percent.

predicted_taxonomy.descr: Best available taxonomic assignment for the genome, ideally including genus/species if resolvable.

taxonomy_assignment_method.descr: Method used to assign taxonomy; examples: GTDB-Tk, 16S rRNA comparison, marker-gene phylogeny.

marker_genes_detected.descr: Marker genes detected in the SAG/assembly, if reported; examples: 16S rRNA, 23S rRNA, recA.

functional_annotation_tool.descr: Software or pipeline used for gene prediction/functional annotation.

metabolic_features_of_interest.descr: Free-text summary of notable metabolic or adaptive features inferred from the genome; examples: sulfur reduction, methanogenesis, thermoadaptation genes.

ecosystem_role_notes.descr: Free-text notes describing the inferred ecological or biogeochemical role of the archaeal genome in the extreme environment.

publication_reference.descr: Primary publication, preprint, or report associated with the record, if available.

data_license.descr: License or reuse terms for the record/data, if specified.
